biotools.summary: CFO is an R package that implements calibration-free odds type Bayesian designs for dose finding in phase I clinical trials, leveraging historical data to identify the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) efficiently and safely. The package includes variants for various scenarios, such as drug-combination trials and late-onset toxicity.
